title: Scenario-driven Docsite: Interactive Recipes, Migration Shims, and API Samples
creator: Maya Chen
description: Revamp the component documentation to prioritize scenario-driven usage patterns, interactive sandboxes, and clear migration shims for legacy token consumers. Deliverables include compact do/don't guidelines, live API examples for button variants, table states, and chart data snapshots, plus a migration appendix that provides token-mapping recipes and a small compatibility shim pattern engineers can adopt. This ticket covers design authoring, content templates, and acceptance criteria for handoff to engineering/docs engineers.
non_goals: Full rewrite of the entire docs site (this ticket focuses on high-value components and tokens)
Replacing upstream developer SDK references; we will link to existing SDK docs instead
goals: Create 6 scenario-driven recipes (auth flows, admin table workflows, dense data table states, low-contrast chart modes, button-driven confirmations, token fallback patterns)
Ship three interactive sandboxes (Button Playground, Table State Switcher, Chart Data Scenarios)
Publish migration appendix with token mapping table and example CSS/JS shim snippet
Provide accessibility notes and keyboard patterns for each component
acceptance_criteria: Docs pages for Buttons, Tables, Charts, and Tokens updated with at least one scenario-driven recipe each
Interactive sandboxes embedded and tested in latest docsite build
Migration appendix includes mapping for colors/spacing/token names and a working shim example with instructions
Design review approved by PM and engineering (recorded in comments)
Automated visual regression snapshots added for each sandbox state (PR linked)
Doc analytics tracking event defined for 'open_sandbox' and 'view_migration_guide'
tasks: Design: Create wireframes for the three sandboxes and recipe layouts
Design: Write do/don't blurbs and accessibility notes for each component
Docs: Create MDX templates and embed sandbox React components
Engineering: Implement lightweight token shim (CSS+JS) and expose sample npm package
Engineering: Add instrumentation events and QA smoke tests
PM: Coordinate rollout and communicate breaking-changes guidance to partners
